texts:
Who earned more of the ball in Week 6 and who is losing it, one number behind each call.

Biggest riser: Kendre Miller in New Orleans.
Biggest faller: Cam Skattebo's 6 snaps.
Let's get into it.
#Saints #NYGiants

Kendre Miller, NO RB: 20 carries on 32 snaps, the most of any Saints back, while Alvin Kamara sat the fourth quarter with the back.
Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.
#Saints

Germie Bernard, PIT WR: targets 9, then 12, with 11 catches and the overtime TD @TB. Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. are on IR.
Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.
#HereWeGo

Omar Cooper Jr., NYJ WR: 82 percent of the snaps in his first game off IR, 6 of 7 for 103 and a TD.
Claim him, 6 to 12 percent of FAAB.
#JetUp

Keenan Allen, IND WR: targets 9, 9 and 11 in Weeks 4 to 6, the Colts' leader with Tyler Warren out.
Claim him, 4 to 8 percent of FAAB.
#ForTheShoe

Emeka Egbuka, TB WR: 36 percent of the targets, then 37, with 25 targets in two weeks from a backup.
WR22 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3.
#GoBucs

Matthew Golden, GB WR: 86 percent of the snaps and 13 targets vs DAL.
WR37 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3.

Chuba Hubbard, CAR RB: 28 carries, no other back over 1.
RB25 for me. Offer a WR3.
#GoPackGo #KeepPounding

Kyle Pitts Sr., ATL TE: 6 targets, then 7 and 21 percent of the share, with 3 TDs in two weeks. The scores sit on real volume.
TE13 rest of season for me. Hold him; do not sell him for a backup tight end.
#DirtyBirds

Luther Burden III, CHI WR: has led Chicago in receiving yards two straight weeks, 8 of 8 for 95 @ATL, on a role still growing.
WR28 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR4 and a bench RB.
#DaBears

Mike Washington Jr., LV RB: a season-high 35 percent of the snaps and half the early downs vs BUF.
RB46 rest of season for me. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.
#RaiderNation

DeMario Douglas, NE WR: targets 5, then 8, with 11 catches and 3 TDs in two weeks and Romeo Doubs on IR.
Add him before Thursday, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Corey Kiner, NE RB: 11 for 57.
Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent.
#NEPats

Bam Knight, ARI RB: 15 carries for 80 on 44 percent of the snaps, and most of the red-zone touches.
Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Tommy Tremble, CAR TE: more routes than Darren Waller for the first time.
Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent.
#BirdGang #KeepPounding

Marvin Harrison Jr., HOU WR: 9 routes on 12 snaps in a planned part-time debut. A second game under half the routes vs NYG would change the call.
WR43 rest of season for me. Hold him; do not sell after a 12-snap game.
#HTownMade

Now the fallers.

Cam Skattebo, NYG RB: 56 snaps, then 6 and no touches. Devin Singletary played 40 percent and Tyrone Tracy Jr. 38.
Monitor; Wednesday's practice report and the Week 7 depth chart.
#NYGiants

Alvin Kamara, NO RB: 12 snaps, then 19, with the back costing him time both weeks.
RB45 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR with a weekly role.
#Saints

Ashton Jeanty, LV RB: 76 percent of the snaps in Weeks 1 to 4, then 53 and 58. The price fell further than the role, so he is a buy for everyone else.
RB8 rest of season for me. Hold him.
#RaiderNation

Tyler Allgeier, ARI RB: 18 carries for 38 to Bam Knight's 15 for 80.
Drop him for Knight.

MarShawn Lloyd, GB RB: 8 for 10, and Josh Jacobs is back.
Drop him for any add.
#BirdGang #GoPackGo

Tyjae Spears, TEN RB: over half the snaps in Week 5, then 1 carry and 1 catch.
Drop him for any add.

Darren Waller, CAR TE: route rate 53 to 45 percent and 0 catches.
Drop him for Tremble.
#TitanUp #KeepPounding

Josh Downs, IND WR: 4 for 40 on 8 targets, behind Keenan Allen a third straight week.
WR36 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench RB.
#ForTheShoe

Rhamondre Stevenson, NE RB: 71 percent of the snaps in Week 5, then 14 for 36 with Corey Kiner out-gaining him.
RB24 for me. Ask for a bench WR with a full-time role.

Rome Odunze, CHI WR: 4 targets with Caleb back.
Monitor his targets Thursday.
#NEPats #DaBears

Bhayshul Tuten, JAX RB: 22 of 24 back carries, then 44 percent of the rushes. RB18 for me; hold through the bye.

Brian Thomas Jr., JAX WR: benched, 0 catches two straight games.
WR42 for me. Ask for a bench receiver.
#DUUUVAL

Omarion Hampton, LAC RB: snap share 58, 63, 42, then 30 percent.
RB14 rest of season for me. Monitor the play-caller decision before Week 8.
#BoltUp

Mike Evans, SF WR: Achilles tendinitis, 3 for 94 Monday. WR26 for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report.

Terry McLaurin, WAS WR: carted off @SF with the knee, team bracing for the worst.
Monitor the MRI result.
#FTTB #RaiseHail

Every riser and faller with its number is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the Menu on Wednesday, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/heat.html?week=7
